# Seq-Browser

> A curated, continuously updated table of sequencing-based assays (single-cell, spatial, temporal and more), tagged by readout, resolution, scope and chemistry, with variant-of links and primary references.

- [Full masterlist (Markdown table)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobertT4n/Seq-Browser/main/METHODS.md): the whole database in one file
- [methods.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobertT4n/Seq-Browser/main/docs/methods.json): same data, machine-readable
- [Label vocabulary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobertT4n/Seq-Browser/main/taxonomy.yaml): allowed values for every tag
- [Repository](https://github.com/RobertT4n/Seq-Browser)
